title: 15 AI Facebook Ad Examples That Drive Sales | HeyOz

facts.fact: The article is dated April 17, 2026 and written by Ahad Shams.

The article defines AI Facebook ads as campaigns that use artificial intelligence at one or more stages of the advertising process, including AI-generated creative, AI-powered audience targeting through Meta's Advantage+ tools, automated bid optimization, and machine-learning-driven performance analysis.
facts.quote: AI Facebook ads are campaigns that use artificial intelligence at one or more stages of the advertising process.

facts.fact: The article's key takeaways state that AI creative generation combined with automated testing enables brands to produce and evaluate 20-50+ ad variations per month (vendor's own claim, not sourced).
facts.quote: AI creative generation combined with automated testing enables brands to produce and evaluate 20-50+ ad variations per month.

facts.fact: In one case study cited by the article (attributed to Social Media Examiner), simple static ads built for an underserved persona became three of the top four performing ads in the account.
facts.quote: became three of the top four performing ads

facts.fact: The article cites a claim (attributed to Social Media Examiner) that UGC-style creatives consistently outperform product shots with the 25-34 age group; no numeric lift is given.
facts.quote: UGC-style creatives consistently outperform product shots
